rationale: One place of truth; every change is attributed and explained in the changelog; hand edits are detected by `validate`.
statement: All project data - design data, equipment, parameters, decisions, document register, sources, references, rules and lessons - lives in `database/records/`. Change it only with `python -m engine db add|update|delete|import|reconcile ... --reason "..."`. Never edit record or changelog files directly. Values used anywhere else come from the database, never retyped.
title: The database is the single source of truth and changes only through the engine CLI
